intent: Write the test for TelemetryIngestController (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/intake/api/TelemetryIngestController.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. Device ingestion endpoint of Telemetry Intake: POST /api/v1/telemetry/packets accepting ONE JSON object (IngressPacketDto) per request. Declared as a handler via class-level @Controller + @RequestMapping with @ResponseBody methods (the controller marker is REQUIRED: WebFlux maps only annotated classes - a marker-less bean is constructed but serves 404; component-scan registration is authoritative, the wiring factory same-name @Bean yields to it and must not duplicate the mapping). Nested public records: IngressPacketDto(String deviceId, List<SampleDto> samples), SampleDto(String metric, Instant tDevice, double value), IngressAck(int accepted). DTO validation is activated by @Valid on the parameter with @NotBlank deviceId, @NotEmpty samples, @NotBlank metric, and tDevice required. ingest reads requestId from the Reactor Context (Mono.deferContextual, fallback "unknown"), maps samples to TelemetrySample (status PENDING, placeholder tIngress Instant.EPOCH, correlationId = requestId), calls the IntakeService instance method receive and answers 202 with IngressAck(accepted). handleValidation is an @ExceptionHandler for WebExchangeBindException returning a 400 ProblemDetail (application/problem+json). DTO shapes stay in this interface layer; the application port speaks domain types only. TEST DUTIES: END-TO-END REQUEST-PATH SLICE: @SpringBootTest(webEnvironment=RANDOM_PORT, properties telemetry.reorder-window-seconds=1) with WebTestClient and DatabaseClient on embedded H2 running the real migrations. Post ONE JSON object (not an array/stream) with X-Request-Id: assert 202 and accepted count, then poll (bounded few seconds) until telemetry_record holds the durable row (an out-of-range heart_rate keeps its value with validation_status VALIDATION_FAILED), a repeated post appends a second revision row, and audit_trail has a row with correlation_id equal to the sent X-Request-Id. Boundary-rejection test: blank deviceId or empty samples gives 400 application/problem+json and no rows. Controller unit tests with a mocked IntakeService are extra.
